## Variant: baseline {#variant-baseline}

<span class="badge status-performance-bearing">performance-bearing</span>

> Uses an off-the-shelf permissive SLM with a deterministic prompt set; reports comparable serving performance with a functional generation check rather than task accuracy.

### At a Glance

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | slm |
| **Model** | SmolLM2-135M-Instruct |
| **Parameters** | 135M |
| **Dataset** | prompt-suite-local |
| **Dataset source** | Deterministic local prompts embedded in the runner; no external evaluation dataset required. |
| **Scenario** | single_stream |
| **Maturity** | base |
| **Candidate result status** | performance-bearing |
| **Provenance** | Off-the-shelf small language model decode path for local serving, quantization, LoRA, KV-cache, and backend comparison studies. |

### How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile max --model smollm2-135m --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile min --model smollm2-135m

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload smollm2-chat-inference --variant baseline --profile pro --model smollm2-135m
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

**Size rationale:** 135M parameters keeps default downloads and local inference practical for coursework while still creating measurable memory, prefill, and decode behavior for systems studies.

**Backend rationale:** The Transformers/PyTorch path works across CPU, MPS, and CUDA and avoids vendor-specific runtimes in the default path; optional backends can be compared as variants later.

| `qwen3-0.6b` | Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B | Newer compact Qwen-family option for optional model-family comparisons; its larger download keeps it out of the default laptop setup. |

**Selection rationale:** SmolLM2-135M-Instruct is the default because it is Apache-2.0, public on Hugging Face, small enough for laptop CPU/MPS setup runs, and large enough to exercise Transformer decode, KV-cache, quantization, batching, and long-context behavior.

**Size rationale:** 135M parameters keeps default downloads and local inference practical for coursework while still creating measurable memory, prefill, and decode behavior for systems studies.

**Backend rationale:** The Transformers/PyTorch path works across CPU, MPS, and CUDA and avoids vendor-specific runtimes in the default path; optional backends can be compared as variants later.

### Implementation

| **Profile** | **Runner entry point** |
|:---|:---|
| min | `mlperf.runners.slm:run_long_context_decode_min` |
| max | `mlperf.runners.slm:run_long_context_decode_max` |
